just_a_zoom.configuration.title: Just A Zoom
just_a_zoom.configuration.enableCinemati: Enable cinematic camera (F8 smooth camera) while zooming. Default: ON
just_a_zoom.configuration.enableSmoothZo: Gradually change FOV like a telescope. Disable for instant switch. Default: OFF
just_a_zoom.configuration.smoothSpeed.to: How fast the FOV transitions (0.01 = slow, 1.0 = fast). Default: 0.1
